title: Credential Diagnosis Result
description: Provider-neutral, runtime-neutral diagnosis result of the Agent Credential Layer. Status, capabilities, failure cause, and recommended resolution are separate semantic layers. The contract never carries credential values; credential sources appear only as metadata and references.

provider.description: Provider identifier handled by an adapter (for example github, pypi, npm). The schema itself depends on no specific provider.

operation.description: Operation being diagnosed (for example push, api, release, publish, auth-check).

executionContext.description: Describes the execution context itself: what kind of context this is and, when safely known, its runtime, platform, and isolation. Probe observations (keyring accessibility, environment propagation, network reachability, tool availability) belong in network, capabilities, credential-source metadata, or evidence, not here.

runtime.description: Kind of execution context, if known; unknown is always permitted.

runtimeIdentifier.description: Safe runtime identifier, if known (for example codex-sandbox). Optional; never required.

platform.description: Generic platform identifier, if safely known (for example linux, darwin, windows). Optional; never required.

isolation.description: Isolation information, if safely known (for example sandbox, container, none, unknown). Optional; never required.

status.description: Overall diagnostic outcome. healthy: the requested credential capability is usable in the current execution context. degraded: a usable path exists, but a preferred or default path is unavailable or impaired. unavailable: no currently usable path was established. inconclusive: the system cannot safely determine availability. Failure causes belong in diagnosis, not in this field.

capabilities.description: Observed non-error capabilities or states. Kept strictly separate from diagnosis failure codes.

availableCredentialSources.description: Credential sources discovered in this context, by metadata and reference only.

selectedCredentialSource.description: The source chosen by resolution, identified by metadata and reference only. Null when no source is selected.

identity.description: Safe provider identity information. Never contains credential values.

network.description: Generic network observations; not specific to any provider.

diagnosis.description: Failure diagnosis. code is the single authoritative primary diagnosis; relatedCodes are optional secondary diagnoses with explicit related semantics and must not duplicate the primary code.

code.description: Primary diagnosis: the single authoritative failure cause. Null when no failure was identified.

relatedCodes.description: Optional secondary diagnoses with explicit related/secondary semantics. Must not duplicate the primary code; duplication is invalid by contract (enforced in consistency validation).

category.description: Coarse category derived from the primary diagnosis code namespace.

conclusive.description: True when the diagnosis is conclusive; false or absent when uncertain.

confidence.description: Optional confidence in the classification, 0 to 1.

summary.description: Human-safe summary. Must never contain credential values.

details.description: Optional safe detail strings; sanitized by construction.

strategy.description: Stable resolution strategy code. Interactive authentication is one strategy among many; it is never an automatic consequence of a single failure code.

actionRequired.description: True when a human or external action is required to complete the resolution.

reauthRequired.description: Policy result computed from the full diagnosis. Never implied by any single diagnostic code; interactive authentication is only reachable after non-interactive recovery is exhausted.

items.description: Structured, sanitized observation. Evidence is sanitized by construction; adapters must not dump command streams into this contract. Provider-specific safe metadata is allowed only in the metadata extension point and carries the same no-credential-value invariant.

check.description: Probe identifier, for example execution-context.keyring or network.endpoint.

outcome.description: Bounded machine-readable outcome of the probe.

code.description: Failure or state code associated with this observation; null when none applies.

summary.description: Optional sanitized human-readable summary. Must never contain credential values.

reference.description: Optional safe metadata or reference associated with the probe; never a credential value.

metadata.description: Explicit safe extension point for provider-specific evidence metadata. Must never carry credential values or command dumps.

evidence.description: Structured, sanitized observations supporting the diagnosis.

extensions.description: Explicit extension point for provider-specific safe metadata. Must never carry credential values.

reference.description: Safe reference only; never a value. Examples: env:CREDENTIAL_NAME, keyring:host, connector:connector-id, file:/absolute/path, broker:name/key. Null when no reference applies (for example interactive).

available.description: Whether the source is available in this execution context.
